settlements.payment_disposition: Unresolved whether there are prior authorisations outside the supplied records. Clause 4 of the lodged deed, certified by Tess Arnay in m4v7, requires the trustees to exercise discretion jointly and an appointment before an object is entitled to payment. Maren Dovell expressly says in j8f2 that her 12 June note authorises no payment. No Alder Quay decision or payment instruction is supplied.
settlements.rhea_marden: Unresolved as an effective addition; not on the supported list. Clause 6 permits identification by parent reference on joint delivery, but Alder Quay's certified reference is PD-6834-R. The proposition that r5n8 records SD-Q7M2 under that reference is explicitly contradicted by the entry's PD-6894-R. The signed designation does not itself name Alder Quay, and the packet does not establish joint delivery for Alder Quay.

settlements.payment_disposition: Unresolved whether there are prior authorisations outside the supplied records. Clause 5 of the lodged deed, certified by Bram Lerrit in x2c9, permits the trustees acting together to apply funds directly for an object's benefit; eligibility alone creates no right to payment. No Flint Orchard decision or payment instruction is supplied. Neither the preparation note nor the supplemental designation authorises payment.
settlements.rhea_marden: Unresolved as an effective addition; not on the supported list. PD-6894-R identifies Flint Orchard, and the custody entry associates it with the exact designation reference SD-Q7M2. That makes Flint Orchard the identified settlement in the custody entry, but does not show that the trustees jointly supplied that reference and delivered the designation as a deed. Receipt into the vault is consistent with effective delivery or custody without effective delivery; the issued copy does not resolve which occurred or when.

companion_register.proposition: SD-Q7M2 was signed and witnessed, and is limited to adding Rhea Marden if it takes effect.
companion_register.origin_reporter_and_date: h6q3 transcribes the signed instrument of Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell, witnessed by Della Pennick. Alys Morcant checked it against the signed paper on 26 March 2026 before handover. No separate signing or effective-delivery date is established.
companion_register.limits: The transcript certificate expressly does not attest to delivery. The propositions that the designation removes an object, appoints property or directs a payment are explicitly contradicted by its terms.

companion_register.proposition: Merefold received the original SD-Q7M2 into the common vault and recorded it against PD-6894-R.
companion_register.origin_reporter_and_date: Gideon Sarn certified the single live-register entry in r5n8 on 11 June 2026. The extract establishes custody receipt but gives no handover date or readable disposition.
companion_register.limits: The register is not the designation, and the checked transcript is not a delivery record. The entry records one original, not a numbered counterpart series. Shared-stock references do not encode a trust or sequence, and the question-mark convention cannot certify a guessed character. Neither the absence of a settlement name on the signed paper nor the unreadable disposition proves non-delivery.

companion_register.proposition: Ione Berrick permitted Sella Quist to forward her replacement travel estimate and asked the trustees to consider helping Sella in her own right.
companion_register.origin_reporter_and_date: Ione reports both matters directly in b9k4, dated 18 February without a stated year. She says the replacement estimate had not arrived and the old one was no longer reliable. The packet supplies no replacement estimate.
companion_register.limits: The permission is limited to forwarding the estimate; broader authority to sign, receive distributions or act for Ione is not evidenced. The claim that Ione requested a standing payment, redirection or deduction is explicitly contradicted by the letter. Sella's eligibility under either deed is unresolved and not established by this request or by her expenses role.
